WITH ClientCardInfo AS (
  SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, c.district_id,
         cd.type AS card_type, cd.issued
  FROM client c
  JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
  JOIN card cd ON cd.disp_id = d.disp_id
  WHERE cd.issued = '1994-03-03'
),
ClientAccountInfo AS (
  SELECT cci.client_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count,
         COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans,
         AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount
  FROM ClientCardInfo cci
  JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = cci.client_id
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
  LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  GROUP BY cci.client_id
)
SELECT
  cci.client_id AS client_id,
  cci.gender AS gender,
  cci.birth_date AS birth_date,
  cci.card_type AS card_type,
  CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', cci.issued) AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', cci.birth_date) AS INTEGER) AS age_at_card_issue,
  cai.account_count AS account_count,
  cai.loan_count AS loan_count,
  cai.active_loans AS active_loans,
  cai.avg_loan_amount AS avg_loan_amount,
  dist.A2 AS district_name,
  dist.A3 AS region,
  dist.A11 AS avg_salary,
  CASE
    WHEN cai.loan_count > 0 AND (CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', cci.issued) AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', cci.birth_date) AS INTEGER)) < 30 THEN 'Young borrower'
    WHEN cai.loan_count > 0 AND (CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', cci.issued) AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', cci.birth_date) AS INTEGER)) >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower'
    ELSE 'Non-borrower'
  END AS borrower_category,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cci.gender ORDER BY cci.birth_date ASC) AS age_rank_by_gender
FROM ClientCardInfo cci
JOIN ClientAccountInfo cai ON cai.client_id = cci.client_id
JOIN district dist ON dist.district_id = cci.district_id
ORDER BY cci.gender, age_rank_by_gender;
